def compute(vars):
    capital_leases = vars["v1"]
    operating_leases = vars["v2"]
    debt_principal = vars["v3"]
    debt_interest = vars["v4"]
    purchase_commitments = vars["v5"]
    pension_fundings = vars["v6"]
    other_liabilities = vars["v7"]

    total = (
        capital_leases
        + operating_leases
        + debt_principal
        + debt_interest
        + purchase_commitments
        + pension_fundings
        + other_liabilities
    )

    return {
        "value": total,
        "trace": {
            "capital_leases": capital_leases,
            "operating_leases": operating_leases,
            "debt_principal": debt_principal,
            "debt_interest": debt_interest,
            "purchase_commitments": purchase_commitments,
            "pension_fundings": pension_fundings,
            "other_liabilities": other_liabilities,
            "output_meta": {
                "currency": "USD",
                "scale": "million",
                "unit": None
            }
        }
    }
